text: A near-miss marker shape is not reported, so the sweep silence covers both "checked and clean" and "never looked at". Measured over twelve plausible shapes: seven are reported, five are silent — [File: x] (a sentence-initial capital), [ file: x ] (inner padding), [file x] (a dropped colon), (file: x), [claim: x]. The cost is specific: the author believes a checked claim was written, and the marker is what tells the next reader it was verified. aix-platform reports these as unchecked pointers, bounding the detector by adjacency rather than by similarity, and states the residual silence as a cost. harnex has a stronger signal available than aix does — the bracket — so resolving strictly while reporting leniently needs no heuristic. Deferred rather than built: the current corpus holds 29 markers and zero near-misses, so the detector would fire nowhere here, and the population that would need it is authors of scaffolded harnesses, of whom none is measured yet.
